[LTES.2.2.2]

| Test shape | Example |
|---|---|
| Golden: source → expected lowered form | feed `.ds` fixture, diff against committed expected lowering |
| Golden: source → expected error | feed malformed `.ds`, expect specific error text + location |
| Negative: reject | confirm illegal source fails to compile |
| Round-trip: parse-format-parse identity | verify formatter output parses back to the same AST |
| Fuzz: random-valid input does not crash | generate valid grammar, compile, expect no crash |
